description.zh: 如果是数据库级备份，需要指定需要备份的数据库列表，多个数据库间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The list of databases to back up if you perform a database-level backup. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).

description.zh:
备份等级，取值范围如下：  
* instance：实例级    
* db：数据库级
description.en:
The backup level. Valid values:  
* instance: instance-level backup    
* db: database-level backup.

description.zh:
备份模式，详情请参见[备份模式](~~108631~~)，取值范围如下：
*  phy：快速备份
* logic：一致性备份
description.en:
The backup mode. For more information, see [Backup modes](~~108631~~). Valid values:

*  phy: fast backup
* logic: consistent backup.
The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

title.zh: 通过提交数据备份任务

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds put-start-backup --drds-instance-id drds0000c6vxxyzd --backup-mode phy --backup-level db --backup-db-names db_1,_db_2 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds PutStartBackup --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds0000c6vxxyzd --BackupMode phy --BackupLevel db --BackupDbNames 'db_1,_db_2'
